title: Manually reviewed HarborLens aggregate release approval
description: Cryptographically signed, reviewer-pinned SHA-256 and purpose assertions; not proof of upstream data rights. The Ed25519 message is the domain separator line harborlens.publication-review.v1, a newline, then the canonical JSON of every field except signature_b64 (sorted keys, compact separators, ASCII escaping, non-finite numbers rejected, trailing newline). A signature that omits that separator is invalid.

reviewed_at_utc.description: RFC3339 UTC date-time. harborlens-release-summary and harborlens-verify-release accept it only when it is not older than 30 days and not more than 5 minutes ahead of the checker clock. The 5 minutes are a fixed clock-skew allowance, not a configuration knob. A date-only value is rejected.
